fact: The Vaccines (MDPI) article by CDC, Ministry of Health and UNICEF authors states that monthly datasets from all health facilities offering vaccination are aggregated at county level and entered by data officers into Liberia's DHIS2-based health management information system managed by the Ministry of Health, which supplies national reports.
WAHO's workshop brings together Liberia's national health information system managers, and the pilot aligns regional indicators with its national DHIS2 system.
